postTitle: Refinancing: When to Refinance and When to Wait
topic: A refinance pays only after its break even month

assumptions.notes: Blog example: closing costs €4,000, monthly saving €200, break even 4,000 / 200 = month 20. Held 60 months: (60 - 20) x 200 = €8,000 ahead; held 24 months: €800. Ignores rate, tax and term changes and the opportunity cost of the costs. Common guideline from the blog: hold period often 2x the break even or more.

hookVariants.narration: If a refinance saves you two hundred euros a month, when has it actually paid off? It is one division.

beats.narration: Say it costs four thousand euros, fees included.
It saves two hundred a month.
Four thousand divided by two hundred: month twenty, before it is ahead.
Many people look for keeping the loan about twice that long, because plans to stay are often hopeful.
